title: Logged model search must eager-load every child relationship that to_mlflow_entity reads
answers: logged-models/search is slow for experiments with many logged models
search_logged_models issues hundreds of SQL queries per page
N+1 queries when listing logged models in the tracking store
why does listing logged models get slower as the page size grows
body:
Symptom: The UI's logged-models/search call takes many seconds for one experiment with hundreds of logged models, even though the database work is about 100 ms.
Root cause: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore.search_logged_models built its query with no loader options, while SqlLoggedModel.to_mlflow_entity reads self.tags, self.params and self.metrics. Those are lazy relationship() attributes, so each model on a page cost three extra SELECTs (3N+1 total).
Fix pattern: Pass selectinload(SqlLoggedModel.<rel>) for each relationship that to_mlflow_entity reads as options() on the main query, as the PR did for tags, params and metrics. This mirrors search_runs, which already uses selectinload for SqlRun.latest_metrics, params and tags. The result is one batched SELECT per relationship (4 queries per page).
Constraints: selectinload is a post-load strategy, so the main statement (filters, ORDER BY, OFFSET/LIMIT) and the page token stay unchanged. Do not use joinedload here, because it wraps the LIMIT query in a subquery. If to_mlflow_entity starts reading a new child relationship, add it to these options too. The test test_search_logged_models_eager_loads_tags_params_and_metrics in tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_runs.py counts statements through a before_cursor_execute listener and asserts one child SELECT per table, so extend it when adding a relationship.
applies: SqlAlchemyStore.search_logged_models and any other store method that converts SqlLoggedModel rows to entities via to_mlflow_entity.
says: Opening the logged models tab takes many seconds in experiments with hundreds of models.
Listing models in an experiment becomes very sluggish as the page size increases.
Speed up the models table when browsing experiments that contain many logged models.
Searching logged models in an experiment spins endlessly before displaying any results.
search: Logged model search in SqlAlchemyStore.search_logged_models must eager-load child relationships (tags, params, and metrics) using selectinload for each attribute read by SqlLoggedModel.to_mlflow_entity. This prevents N+1 lazy queries per model and mirrors search_runs by batching child loading into one SELECT per relationship. Use selectinload rather than joinedload, which wraps the LIMIT query in a subquery, and keep the main statement and pagination tokens unchanged. Any new child relationship read by to_mlflow_entity must be added to options and verified in tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_runs.py:test_search_logged_models_eager_loads_tags_params_and_metrics.
